messages:
oliver: Quick sync — Helio Systems wants to run a joint perf/W + kernel-tune sweep Wed 10/14. Can we scope this? Looking for 2 configs, p95<=8ms target, and watt-per-token baseline.

maya: +1. Need device serials and exact firmware. Who's owning telemetry ingest?

ben: I can own telemetry. Will push a prometheus job and export host-level powermetrics. Need run-id and sample rate (recommend 5s).

chris_helio: hey all, Helio Ops here. We can supply perf counters and a custom firmware build. Prefer Wed-Thu window. Requesting an early smoke Tue morning.

oliver: Smoke Tue works. Bench-bot created run: run-2026-4943. Config attached: 
```yaml
run_id: run-2026-4943
models:
  - name: gpt-j-6B
    quant: q4_0
devices:
  - helio-1a (4x)
  - redwood-pool-2 (8x)
kernels: ['fast-attn-v2','kv-cache-opt']
sample_rate_s: 5
metrics: ['latency_p50','latency_p95','tokens_per_sec','watts']
```

maya: Can we add a prefix-cache test and a sequence-length sweep? 128 / 512 / 2048. Also want to capture temp sensors.

ben: adding seq sweep and temp sensors. Will tag prometheus: job=helio-joint, run=run-2026-4943. Storing raw and 1m aggregates.

sara: I'll coordinate canary routing + fallback policy. Need model-variant mapping and expected fallback list (e.g., q4->q8_safe).

priya: FYI legal asked for a short MoU & data-sharing scope. @chris_helio can Helio sign one-page telemetry consent? (I attached the template link)

chris_helio: yes, will get signature by Mon EOD. Also prepping firmware bundle and perf counters list.

oliver: Action items: Ben (telemetry + dashboards), Maya (test matrix + kernels), Sara (routing & fallbacks), Priya (MoU), Chris (firmware + signed consent). Smoke Tue 09:00 PT, full sweep Wed 06:00-18:00 PT. :calendar:

ben: noted — will share Grafana link once job starts. :rocket:

bench-bot: run-2026-4943 scheduled, smoke-deploy queued -> smoke-2026-4943 at 2026-10-13T16:00:00Z

oliver: thanks everyone — please post smoke logs here and tag me. We'll do a short retro Thu morning.
